title: Describe a person who has strongly influenced your life.
bullet_points: Who this person is and how you know them
What kind of person they are
What specific things they have done or taught you
Explain why their influence has been so significant to you
part3_follow_up_questions: What types of people typically have the greatest influence on young children?
Do you think public figures and celebrities have a moral responsibility to be good role models?
How has social media changed the way people are influenced compared to the past?

title: Describe a quiet place that you like to visit.
bullet_points: Where this place is located
How often you go there
What you usually do when you are there
Explain why you find this place particularly peaceful
part3_follow_up_questions: Why is it becoming increasingly difficult to find quiet spaces in modern urban environments?
What are the psychological effects of prolonged exposure to noise pollution?
Should municipal governments invest more funds in creating urban parks and green spaces?

title: Describe a piece of electronic equipment that you find indispensable.
bullet_points: What the item is and when you acquired it
How often you use it in your daily life
What specific features or functions you rely on most
Explain how your routine would be impacted without it
part3_follow_up_questions: Has society become overly dependent on digital devices for basic daily functions?
What challenges do older generations face when adapting to rapidly evolving consumer electronics?
Do you think smart devices improve human productivity or simply create new distractions?

title: Describe an important traditional festival or celebration in your culture.
bullet_points: What the celebration is and when it takes place
What preparations people make in advance
What activities, rituals, or foods are associated with it
Explain why this festival holds enduring cultural significance
part3_follow_up_questions: Are traditional celebrations losing their original meaning due to commercialisation?
How do national celebrations help foster a cohesive sense of cultural identity?
Is it important for schools to teach children about traditions from other global cultures?

title: Describe a difficult decision that you had to make.
bullet_points: What the decision was and when you faced it
What different options or choices were available to you
What factors made the decision particularly challenging
Explain whether you believe you made the right choice in retrospect
part3_follow_up_questions: What qualities distinguish effective decision-makers in leadership positions?
Should young adults rely more on parental guidance or their own intuition when choosing a career?
How does fear of failure impede people from taking decisive action in life?

title: Describe a creative artist, writer, or musician that you admire.
bullet_points: Who they are and what field of art they work in
How you first became familiar with their work
What unique characteristics distinguish their creations
Explain why their creative work inspires or resonates with you
part3_follow_up_questions: Do you think government subsidies are necessary to sustain the fine arts?
How has digital media impacted the financial viability of independent artists?
Should art education be given equal priority to STEM subjects in secondary schools?

title: Describe a city or foreign destination that you would love to explore in the future.
bullet_points: Where this destination is located
What you know about its culture, architecture, or environment
What specific sights or activities you want to experience there
Explain why visiting this destination holds special appeal for you
part3_follow_up_questions: How does international travel broaden an individual's worldview and tolerance?
What can tourist destinations do to mitigate the negative impacts of over-tourism?
Do virtual reality tours offer a credible alternative to physical travel?

title: Describe a book or piece of literature that left a lasting impression on you.
bullet_points: What the title and genre of the book is
Who the author is and when you read it
What central theme or plot line captivated you
Explain why this book continues to influence your thinking
part3_follow_up_questions: Why are reading habits declining among adolescents in the smartphone era?
Does reading fiction improve empathy and social intelligence more than non-fiction?
Will digital audiobooks and e-readers eventually render traditional paper books obsolete?

title: Describe a public sporting event or competition that you attended or watched.
bullet_points: What event it was and where it occurred
Who was competing and what was at stake
What the atmosphere was like during the event
Explain why this particular event was memorable for you
part3_follow_up_questions: Do major international sporting events like the Olympics bring economic value to host cities?
Why do competitive sports provoke such intense emotional tribalism among fans?
Should governments allocate more funds to grassroots sports rather than elite athletes?

title: Describe a time when you helped someone or volunteered in your community.
bullet_points: Who you helped and what circumstances led to it
What specific assistance or service you provided
What challenges you encountered during the process
Explain how you felt after completing the experience
part3_follow_up_questions: What motivates individuals to dedicate unpaid time to community volunteering?
Can altruistic behavior be actively nurtured through school educational programmes?
Do non-governmental charities manage social crises more effectively than state bureaucracies?
